rows.definition: A lightweight logical agent execution context containing only a task delta, bounded mutable state, capabilities, budget, continuation identity, and output contract over an immutable shared agent base.
rows.distinction: A logical scheduling and isolation unit over one shared base; not a full harness process, not a provider context-window limit, and not context-MMU result-byte admission.

rows.definition: The Go command that runs the synthetic S0 micro-context research spine.
rows.distinction: A runnable proof command, not the micro-context concept, not a production harness, and not a model-throughput benchmark.
